pages.text: The Life Conversion Matrix is currently the only thing that can "brew" life energy: form it automatically by enclosing a 3×3×3 sealed structure with the controller, matrix casings, and energy ports.$(br)Position it right and it's your life-energy money printer.

Akaishi energy is injected through the energy input into the matrix center; once formed it runs up to 45 conversions per tick (10M energy each → 10 life energy).$(br)Feed it more power, and it brews life faster.

Life energy exits through the energy output (pipe extraction only); pair it with life-energy pipes to drive sample collection, organ research, and the devices that follow.$(br)That output is the "first drop" of life tech.
